objective: Integrate the Phase 13 image-preview component into the existing single-image InferencePage input workflow while preserving request mapping, asynchronous inference, folder mode, cancellation, export, and close coordination.
acceptance_criteria: InferencePage contains one clearly labelled preview area associated with the Single Image input and does not create a second inference path or preview model output.
Selecting an image through the existing Browse action refreshes the preview, and an explicitly committed manual path refreshes it through a deterministic user action without filesystem polling.
An empty or unreadable path shows the component's neutral or unavailable state without changing the text entered in the request field and without bypassing existing InferenceRequest validation.

Changing from Single Image to Folder hides or clears single-image preview presentation so it cannot be mistaken for a folder result; returning to Single Image deterministically reflects the current image path.
Starting, finishing, failing, cancelling, rerunning, exporting, or closing inference preserves the established Phase 6 through Phase 12 thread, signal, control, result, and cleanup contracts.
Preview work remains synchronous bounded local decoding on the GUI path and never runs model inference, CUDA, network access, directory scans, background workers, or file watchers.
Existing single-image and folder public APIs, portable artifact and export schemas, request construction, and MainWindow tab integration remain unchanged.

Tests use local temporary images and fake inference backends, validate widget state programmatically, and contain no screenshot comparison, arbitrary sleep, assertion weakening, or unregistered marker.
claude_prompt: Implement Phase 13 CP2 only in src/image_ai_studio/gui/inference_page.py and tests/gui/test_inference_page.py, reusing the CP1 image-preview component. Add one minimal Single Image input-preview area. Existing Browse selection and a deterministic committed manual-path action must refresh it; do not poll the filesystem. Empty/invalid paths must not rewrite request text or weaken existing validation. Folder mode must not display a stale single-image preview, and returning to Single Image must reflect the current path. Preserve every existing request mapping, QThread/worker connection, overlap guard, folder progress/cancellation, partial export, rerun, close cleanup, public API, and schema. Use fake inference backends and tmp_path images only; do not run actual inference, CUDA, network, screenshots, sleeps, or Git. Do not remove or weaken assertions, create a new marker, or modify any other file.
estimated_scope: Focused integration in one existing GUI module and its existing test module, approximately 140-240 changed lines.
